source: Nexon: v.272 Maplayer One Patch Notes (news id 47132) and Inkwell's Note: Maplayer One (news id 46613, 17 Oct 2026). These entries were typed in by hand on 24 Nov 2026.

items.title: HEXA Matrix and Erda Link Reset Scrolls expire
